en: Karmic dice nudged {unit} from a {raw} to a {corrected}.
Changes take effect after Apply changes, at the start of the next combat. No restart needed.

On: only your own mechs get karma. 
Off: everyone does, enemies included.

Off: a bad result is a low raw d20 (see Low roll threshold), on every d20 roll. 
On: a bad result is a MISSED ATTACK; saves and checks are ignored unless Mixed mode is on.
Only matters when Outcome-aware is on: saves, checks and other non-attack d20s then use the low-roll rule and count toward the same run.

Off: adds Strength to the die. 
On: rolls ONE extra d20 and keeps the higher (Strength is ignored).

Off: a corrected roll is capped at 19, so karma never crits. 
On: it may reach 20 and crit.
How many bad results in a row before karma corrects the next roll. 1 to 20.
A raw d20 at or below this counts as bad (blind and mixed modes). 1 to 19.
Bonus added to the d20 once karma is active. 1 to 19. Ignored in reroll mode.
